mentions.name: housetrained
mentions.description: This self-hosted app tracks puppy potty breaks to help with house training. It is a fork of the open-source Baby Buddy package, customized for pet potty tracking, and runs locally for privacy reasons.
mentions.problem: The author needed a way to track puppy potties to help with house training a new puppy.
mentions.audience: Needed a way to track puppy potties to help with house training a new puppy.
mentions.source_excerpt: We just got a puppy, and needed a way to track potties to help us with house training. So, with AI/Claude's help, I found a similar open source package (Baby Buddy), forked it, and very quickly made it my own. Self-hosted, local for privacy reasons.
mentions.author: bsmith
